messages:
Aisha - CSM: Quick sync — Vanguard private/VPC onboarding. Need green on firewall rules, IAM roles, KMS key access, and audit log streaming before handoff. Renewal review scheduled 11/30; we should de-risk if possible. Anyone have status?

Tom - Infra Eng: On firewalls — asked Vanguard NetOps for allowed egress CIDR and proxy NAT ranges. They sent 10.8.0.0/16 + a few static NATS IPs. Still waiting on their proxy NAT list so we can finalize the rw-vanguard-allow ACL.

Priya - Solutions Eng: Ran a canary yesterday, hit 403 on kms:Decrypt when calling model store. Looks like their role is missing KMS perms. Minimal policy I'll attach below.

Priya - Solutions Eng: ```json
{
  "Action": ["kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"],
  "Resource": "arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456789012:key/abcd-efgh",
  "Effect": "Allow"
}
```

Luca - Security Eng: Audit logs — Vanguard wants CloudTrail -> S3 with SSE-KMS and replication to their archive account. I provisioned the pipeline but we need their bucket ARN + the KMS key alias they want us to use for server-side encryption. Also confirm retention (they suggested 90 days).

AuditBot: cloudtrail-vanguard pipeline created (id: ct-9821). Status: awaiting bucket policy acceptance by vanguard-logs-prod.

Aisha - CSM: Action items: 1) Tom follow up for proxy NAT ranges and finalize firewall rule named `rw-vanguard-allow`. 2) Priya update IAM role to include kms:Decrypt + share policy doc. 3) Luca collect final bucket ARN + KMS alias and confirm retention. If we ship by next Thu (11/18) I'll mark renewal risk as low.

Tom - Infra Eng: Will ping their NetOps (vanguard-netops@vanguard.com) and add task to CS ticket #CS-2439.

Priya - Solutions Eng: Quick command I'm using to attach the policy: `aws iam put-role-policy --role-name RedwoodVanguardRole --policy-document file://vanguard-kms.json` — I'll drop the full policy in the ticket.

Aisha - CSM: Also capture enablement feedback: Vanguard asked for a 1-page checklist on how to validate KV cache heat-up and token/cost breakdowns during smoke tests. Priya, can you add that to the docs?

Priya - Solutions Eng: Yep — drafting a 1-page checklist and a tiny script to hit prefix cache endpoints. ETA tomorrow morning, will post to #docs and link in the ticket.

Luca - Security Eng: Note for compliance: they specifically requested KMS key-id included in each audit event. CloudTrail includes KMS fields when SSE-KMS is used, but we'll verify post-setup and add a small alert if key-id missing.

Aisha - CSM: Solid. I'll update the account health tracker: onboarding=near-complete, blockers=KMS perms + bucket acceptance, owner=Vanguard NetOps. Thanks all :thumbsup:
